rationale: SNDK has the cleanest long STRUCTURE in the book (L/S 0.86 not crowded, orderbook +0.53, ADX 67.7 strong uptrend, low BTC-beta 0.10) but price is stretched +8.6% above VWAP with 4h RSI 71 and %B 0.84 near the upper band — textbook late-chase territory that this account's losers repeatedly died in.
